description: Cursor Agent via its native ACP subcommand. Subscription access stays in your Cursor login; Garuda never reads it.
warnings: Vendor capability mediation is negotiated at handshake; strict garuda-only policies may be refused — review before mutating runs.
setup: 1. Install the Cursor Agent CLI and log in with your Cursor account. 2. Verify: cursor-agent --version. Garuda never reads your Cursor credentials.

login.instructions: Log in to the Cursor Agent CLI, then select this runtime.
